name: Financial Assistance for Cremation (BBOCWWB)
briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Cremation" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/-to the dependents of the deceased worker for performing cremation.
descriptionMd: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Cremation" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/-to the dependents of the deceased worker for performing cremation.
benefitsMd: Financial Assistance of ₹5,000/- is provided for the cremation of the deceased construction worker.
eligibilityMd:
- The applicant should be a dependent of the deceased construction worker.
- The deceased, in his/her lifetime, should have been registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The deceased, in his/her lifetime, should have maintained regular membership with the Board.
applicationMd:
&gt; **Application**

**Step 1:****** Visit the [Official Website ](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Website/SchemeApply.aspx)of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
**Step 2:** Click on &amp;quot;[Scheme Application](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Website/SchemeApply.aspx)&amp;quot; and select &amp;quot;[Apply for Scheme](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Registration/SchemeTaggingWeb.aspx)&amp;quot;.
**Step 3:****** Enter your registration number and click &amp;quot;Show&amp;quot; to view your details.
**Step 4:****** Select the scheme you intend to apply for, enter all mandatory information and upload the necessary documents in the specified format and size.
**Step 6:****** Click on &amp;quot;Submit Application&amp;quot; to complete the process.
&gt; **Application Tracking**

Applicants can track their application status online on the [official website ](https://bocw.bihar.gov.in/Registration/ApplicationStatus.aspx)of the Board by providing their registration number.
